findings.issue: This is the dare that completes the threat carried by another bark in the same namespace - 'Stay your hand, brether... or else.' أم ماذا؟ is the 'or what else?' of an alternative question and reads as a request for options, not a challenge. (Co-location in the HitReactions bark set, not row order - these keys are hash-tailed.)

findings.source_en: You’ve come to make me the High Lord of Mammon?
findings.issue: Second instance of the Mammon spelling split (the other is in chunk 093). It is مَمُّون everywhere else in this range - 'عرش مَمُّون', 'عملة مَمُّون', 'خريطة مَمُّون'.
